description: This file defines the OrganizationModel class within the OrangeHRM system, which is an API model representing an organization's data for serialization and normalization purposes. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for common serialization behavior. The class is constructed with an Organization entity and includes a set of filters for its properties.

classes.name: OrganizationModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing and normalizing Organization entity data within the OrangeHRM API framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OrganizationModel with an Organization entity and sets the filters for serialization.
